decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9117. Series context: trend strength 0.924 and seasonal strength 0.7319; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.407); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.646.
